user.title: xquirks
user.description:
xquirks adds device definitions to ZHA for Zigbee devices that ZHA does not fully support yet.

Setup writes the start file `xquirks.py` and its options file `xquirks_options.json` into ZHA's custom quirks folder `{folder}`. From then on, the start file loads the definitions each time ZHA starts.

Where a quirk of yours or one of ZHA's own quirks matches a device, that quirk stays. Exception: a few definitions take over a quirk of ZHA to add what it lacks. They keep all of its entities.

A reload of ZHA makes your Zigbee devices unavailable for a few seconds.

menu_options.reload: Set up and reload ZHA now
menu_options.later: Set up, ZHA loads the definitions at its next start

abort.no_folder:
ZHA has no custom quirks folder yet.

1. Create the folder, for example `/config/custom_zha_quirks` (with the File editor, Samba or SSH app). It has to exist before the next step.
2. Add these lines to `configuration.yaml`:

```yaml
zha:
  custom_quirks_path: /config/custom_zha_quirks/
```

3. Restart Home Assistant, then add xquirks again.

xquirks cannot use its options file: {error}

Fix the file or delete it, then open the options again. Without the file, no device is left alone and high-risk definitions stay off.

missing_quirks_path.title: ZHA has no custom quirks folder
missing_quirks_path.description:
ZHA loads custom quirks only from a folder named in `configuration.yaml`. Until there is one, xquirks loads no definitions.

1. Create the folder, for example `/config/custom_zha_quirks` (with the File editor, Samba or SSH app). It has to exist before the next step.
2. Add these lines to `configuration.yaml`:

```yaml
zha:
  custom_quirks_path: /config/custom_zha_quirks/
```

3. Restart Home Assistant. A repair then offers to write the xquirks start file.

quirks_disabled.title: ZHA loads no quirks
quirks_disabled.description:
`enable_quirks: false` under `zha:` in `configuration.yaml` turns off every quirk: ZHA's own, yours and the xquirks definitions.

Remove that line or set it to `true`, then restart Home Assistant.

confirm.title: Write the start file again
confirm.description:
The start file `xquirks.py` in ZHA's custom quirks folder `{folder}` loads the xquirks definitions each time ZHA starts. It is missing or differs from the one this version of xquirks writes.

**Submit** writes it again and reloads ZHA. Your Zigbee devices are unavailable for a few seconds.
